caption_en:
The loudest table in the world has a secret. 🍽️

👨 Dad: opinions. 5 Knesset elections between April 2019 and November 2022.
👩 Mom: 2.9 children per woman, the highest in the OECD, the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development, where the average is about 1.5 (OECD Society at a Glance 2024; CBS: 2.88 in 2025).
🧒 The kids: one in three Israelis (31.7%) is under 18 (CBS, end of 2024).
👵 Grandma: Israeli women live to 85.7 on average (Israel CBS, 2023 data, published 2026).
🧒 And the young ones: Israel's under 25s rank 3rd happiest in the world (World Happiness Report 2026, via JNS).
🍽️ The whole table: 8th happiest country on Earth (World Happiness Report 2026).

Crowded, nobody agrees, everybody shows up.

Which seat is yours at this table? Tell me in the comments.

Photos (Wikimedia Commons): Crzrussian (CC BY-SA 3.0); IPPA (CC BY 4.0); MathKnight and Zachi Evenor (CC BY-SA 4.0); Dan Harrelson (CC BY 2.0); Yong Woo Park (CC BY 4.0). AI voice.
caption_he:
5 בחירות בפחות מארבע שנים. ועדיין המקום השמיני בעולם באושר?
דמיינו את ישראל כארוחת שישי אחת, עשרה מיליון כיסאות.
אבא: דעות. 5 מערכות בחירות. אמא: 2.9 ילדים לאישה, כשהממוצע ב־OECD הוא 1.5. הילדים: אחד מכל שלושה ישראלים מתחת לגיל 18. סבתא: נשים בישראל חיות בממוצע עד 85.7.
והילדים בשולחן הרועש הזה? הצעירים השלישיים הכי מאושרים בעולם.
אף אחד לא מסכים. כולם מגיעים. איזה כיסא שלכם?

sources.label: World Happiness Report, under 25s, via JNS

lines.line: Five elections in under four years. And still the eighth happiest country?
To get it, picture Israel as one family dinner. Ten million seats.
Dad has opinions. So does everyone. Five elections, from April twenty nineteen to November twenty twenty two.
Mom? Almost three kids per woman. The rich country average is one and a half.
So the kids are everywhere. One Israeli in three is under eighteen.
And Grandma isn't going anywhere. Israeli women live to almost eighty six.
Now the clue. The kids at this loud table are the third happiest young people on Earth.
Maybe that's the secret. A loud table is a full table.
Crowded, nobody agrees, everybody shows up. The eighth happiest family on Earth.
Which seat is yours at this table?
If you love Israeli facts, follow Noam Roz for more.
So how is a family this loud this happy?
